text.p: Lithuania's securities commission said on Monday that it registered an 18 million litas share issue for spirits producer Sema on Friday.
The commission also said in a statement that the issue will be made from additional contributions and that the company's share capital after the increase will be 38.7 million litas.
Investment house Williams de Broe confirmed earlier that it was in talks with the company and Lithuanian brokerage house Vilfima to distribute part of the issue.
One month after the registration of the issue is announced in the mass media the current shareholders have the priority right to buy in proportionally, the company said earlier.
The state holds a 27 percent stake in the company but the government said last week that it had no plans to buy into the issue.
Sema is listed on the A group of the Vilnius bourse.
